results.title: Courtesy Call on State Minister NAKASONE by the European Parliament Committee on Security and Defence | Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
results.snippet:
On October 27, commencing at 5:15 p.m. for approximately 30 minutes, Mr. NAKASONE Yasutaka, State Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan, received a courtesy call from a delegation of six members of the European Parliament Committee on Security and Defence, led by Ms. Marie-Agnes Strack-Zimmermann, Chair of the Committee.
